title: Drumm puts his head in the magnetic hole at Oami Gaishi stone circle
summary: Geoffrey Drumm tells of Drumm puts his head in the magnetic hole at Oami Gaishi stone circle, about 2020s at Japan (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: like sticking my head in this. It's exactly a head-shaped hole in this huge anesite stone that has this profound magnetic field

plain: Geoffrey Drumm, a man who says he has studied the true purpose of the pyramids, says that in the 2020s he visited the Oami Gaishi stone circle in Japan. There, he says, he put his head into a hole shaped exactly like a head, carved in a huge andesite stone that gives off a strong magnetic field. He tells it as a sign that ancient stones were built for a purpose beyond the obvious.
